goal: Schedule operators can view local summaries, complete traces, refresh results, and logistics risks.
non_goals: Do not add SSE, direct Provider calls, PII, or automatic device release.
Do not duplicate complete tracking data inside schedule blocks.
expected_evidence: Frontend model, polling, drawer, state, theme, and locale tests
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Do not assume all orders have packages or details load in order.
Do not infer Provider status, throttle, risk, or device state in the browser.
stop_condition: Stop if UI needs raw Provider data, PII, direct Provider access, or authoritative backend logic.
